acceptance_scope: Count all new-policy shadow proposals on ALL 36 trajectories, not just actual active-envelope exclusions. Compare active prior/envelope numerical outcomes on independently trained paired trajectories.
decision: Union of original confirmed-current candidates and confirmed non-receding individual-envelope candidates. Geometry-only head rejected on development false positives. Individual raw-risk limits are clean client/view maxima + .05; peak retention .5, two consecutive retained rounds, reset on non-high/unsupported context. Historical evidence cannot authorize action.

experimental_acceptance.active_envelope_final_macro_F1_within_0_: Each of six attacked pairs; absolute drop at most .02.
experimental_acceptance.active_envelope_peak_ASR_not_worse_than_: Each of six attacked paired seeds; tolerance only 1e-12.
experimental_acceptance.no_active_quorum_failure: Every active trajectory finishes with minimum 8 positive contributors.
experimental_acceptance.shadow_non_iid_recall_strictly_above_pri: Compare on identical no-intervention shadow prefixes, aggregate three non-IID seeds.
experimental_acceptance.zero_currently_clean_scheduled_attacker_: All non-attacking rounds, including pre-onset, clean gaps and post-cessation.
experimental_acceptance.zero_never_attacker_envelope_proposals: All trajectories, including unexecuted new-policy shadow proposals.

public_policy_variant_selector: Worker knows algorithm choice (prior/envelope), never attack mode, seed or schedule.
